capabilities: autosave graph node positions at a set interval
restore the graph layout with a smooth node animation
create, rename, delete and switch between layout snapshots
shuffle nodes to generate a new layout
optionally save filters, groups, display, forces and per-workspace layouts
extras: Restoring an old snapshot after adding new notes keeps the newer nodes instead of deleting them; manual installation instructions are included.
intentEvidence: Graph Save is inspired by obsidian-persistent-graph. It tries to fix some of its papercuts
motivation: The author finds the graph-as-spatial-map powerful, but Obsidian re-rendering nodes at random locations each time makes the feature impractical, and the plugin aims to address that gap.
problem: Obsidian's graph view re-renders nodes at random positions every time it opens, so a deliberate spatial arrangement of notes is lost.

relations.evidence: Graph Save is inspired by obsidian-persistent-graph. It tries to fix some of its papercuts

summary: Graph view helper that automatically saves and restores graph node positions, with named layout snapshots.
